answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 19658 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Is it permissable to consume food from a place where Pork is cooked?Untensils used for cooking & serving this food are different.Since,It is a company canteen,all colleagues sit together in one large hall,with differnt tables assigned for pork consuming people.Can we eat in such atmosphere.Secondly,Is a Muslim chef allowed to cook Pork for others since it is his job. Question: Dear Scholars,As'salamu alaikum,Is it permissable to consume food from a place where Pork is cooked?Untensils used for cooking & serving this food are different.Since,It is a company canteen,all colleagues sit together in one large hall,with differnt tables assigned for pork consuming people.Can we eat in such atmosphere.Secondly,Is a Muslim chef allowed to cook Pork for others since it is his job. Kindly reply. Jazak allah khair. Answer ID: 19658 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 320/320/M=1431) One should avoid staying or eating even halal food at a place where pork is cooked. A Muslim cook is not supposed to cook pork for others, he should leave this job and look for a lawful work. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
